question: Alluvial soil is mainly found in which region of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Indo-Gangetic Plain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alluvial soil** is one of the most fertile soils and is ideal for agriculture.
 
• This soil is predominantly found in the **Indo-Gangetic Plain**, which is formed by the deposition of sediments carried by rivers such as the **Ganga, Yamuna, Brahmaputra, and their tributaries.**
 
• The **Indo-Gangetic Plain** stretches across the northern states of India, including Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, and Assam.</strong
